grades.lower_bound_mechanism: finite-transversal lemma for pairwise-intersecting prime supports
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: residue periodicity mod L=lcm(b_j); T=#S-residues per length-L window
grades.notes: Essentially complete proof: (C) and (P) fully rigorous; global periodicity from n=1, not eventual. Finiteness lemma is true and the mechanism correct, but its induction has a real gap: transversals X disjoint from C are dismissed via the false claim that the designated transversal is always a family member; repairable by adding union sets over choices of D_{c,k}.
